verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time and export all your channels, which covers the whole knowledge base. Markdown is offered as an export format, an open format a switcher can take elsewhere. Missing for 10: evidence on how much structure survives Markdown export (relations, Types, databases, links), clarity on whether Any-Block is an open or documented format, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a full-vault exit.
